meta.name: Salvador
meta.description: During a violent confrontation arranged between radical fans of two football clubs, Salvador Aguirre, an ambulance driver, rescues his injured daughter Milena, a member of the ultra group, which defends racist, violent and homophobic values, totally opposed to those he instilled in her.

videos.title: Night of Sirens
videos.overview: On a tense night in Madrid, as Spanish and French hooligans face off, an ambulance driver reels from seeing his daughter among the violent crowd.

videos.title: Conflicting Feelings
videos.overview: At the funeral, a bereft Salvador is caught off guard, drawing unwanted attention. As the police investigation stalls, he looks for answers elsewhere.

videos.title: "Quid Pro Quo"
videos.overview: As Salvador's perspective starts to shift and Julia edges closer to Nacho, the White Souls need someone to take the fall for the Molotov cocktail.

videos.title: Minute of Silence
videos.overview: A heated incident on the job pulls Salvador and Marjane apart. The White Souls pay homage to Milena as they prepare to wreak havoc in Marseille.

videos.title: Siren Songs
videos.overview: When footage from the airport makes headlines, Salvador hits another low point. Disgusted by a new narrative being peddled, Martín doesn't hold back.

videos.title: The Dinner
videos.overview: Hoping to move on, Salvador lays Milena to rest. But as violent footage of her murder goes viral, he attends an explosive dinner in the lion's den.

videos.title: "Incel"
videos.overview: As Milena's killer becomes known to a select few, Martín, Carla and Julia face uncomfortable truths while others race to control the story.

videos.title: A Father
videos.overview: With Nacho and Tibu hot on their tail, Salvador and Marjane race to save a patient in need. As the house of cards collapses, past loyalties dissolve.
